content.title: 3 Russell 2000 Stocks We Steer Clear Of
content.summary: The Russell 2000 (^RUT) is packed with potential breakout stocks, thanks to its focus on smaller companies with high growth potential. However, smaller size also means these businesses often lack the resilience and financial flexibility of large-cap firms, making careful selection crucial.

content.title: 3 Profitable Stocks We Keep Off Our Radar
content.summary: Not all profitable companies are built to last - some rely on outdated models or unsustainable advantages. Just because a business is in the green today doesn’t mean it will thrive tomorrow.

content.title: 3 Stocks Under $50 We Find Risky
content.summary: Stocks trading between $10 and $50 can be particularly interesting as they frequently represent businesses that have survived their early challenges. However, investors should remain vigilant as some may still have unproven business models, leaving them vulnerable to the ebbs and flows of the broader market.

content.title: BTSG Q3 Deep Dive: Specialty Pharmacy and Infusion Growth Offset Customer Shifts
content.summary: Healthcare services provider BrightSpring Health Services (NASDAQ:BTSG) reported revenue ahead of Wall Streets expectations in Q3 CY2025, with sales up 14.7% year on year to $3.33 billion. The company’s full-year revenue guidance of $12.65 billion at the midpoint came in 0.9% above analysts’ estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $0.30 per share was 13.9% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
